# Required status checks for the `main-protection` ruleset.
#
# One status-check CONTEXT per line — the exact string GitHub shows on the PR,
# which is a job's `name:` if it has one, otherwise its job id.
#
# This file is the committed half of a contract with GitHub's branch-protection
# settings. `tools/check_ci_contract.py` enforces two things about it:
#
#   * every context here resolves to a real job in a workflow that runs on
#     EVERY pull request (no `paths:` filter) — a filtered-out workflow never
#     reports a conclusion, so the PR blocks forever instead of passing
#   * `--verify-ruleset` diffs this list against the live ruleset, so the repo
#     and GitHub's settings cannot drift apart silently
#
# CHANGING THE REQUIRED SET IS A TWO-SIDED EDIT. Update this file AND the
# ruleset together. Adding a check here that is paths-filtered, or requiring one
# in the ruleset without listing it here, is the PR #1365 deadlock — see that
# PR and the tool's docstring for the full incident.

Python (ruff)
Markdown (markdownlint-cli2)
drift-check
unittest
